messages:
alex: Morning — quick async: Adaptive Routing v2 rollout status. What I did: finalized canary rules and opened the infra PR. Blocker: need SRE sign-off on autoscaling policy; seeing some p99 spikes on staging. Today: aim to get SRE sign-off, merge infra PR, and close spec gaps. @chris @maria please.
chris: Re autoscaling — looked at staging metrics. p99 jumps around ~600ms at higher QPS. My hypothesis: KV cache miss storm + reranker tails. I'll add a temporary dynamic throttle flag to smooth tails. /cc @soumya
soumya: Running a short synthetic workload against the canary now, will dump traces. Found long-context reranker queries causing KV churn. Trace link: https://internal/traces/qwe123
maria: On the spec side — priority-pinning API needs an explicit fallback when capacity is low. I added a paragraph in the spec doc: https://docs.redwood/pri-pin#fallback. I'm OOO after 1pm.
alex: Thanks. chris — can you post the PR link for the throttle so I can include it in release notes?
chris: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/472 — adds dynamic throttle + feature flag. Left a TODO to update unit tests for batching.
deploy-bot: CI build #472 passed for inference @canary. :white_check_mark:
pat: Quick FYI — blocked on UX decision for "model fallback" copy. @maria if you're OOO, can someone from design pick it up? It's holding the docs deadline.
emma-design: I can take that. Will sync with pat offline and push copy by 3pm.
soumya: Synthetic run finished. Results: p99 reduced ~20% with throttle but throughput dropped ~5%. Logs snippet:
```
# staging run 2026-03-16T09:12Z
p50: 90ms p95: 180ms p99: 640ms -> 520ms
throughput: 190rps -> 180rps
```
alex: Sounds reasonable for canary. Who can review infra PR today? Need a second reviewer besides chris.
maria: I can do a code review this morning before OOO — will leave detailed comments.
chris: pinging #eng-sre for autoscale knobs and rollback playbook.
eng-sre-bot: Notified #eng-sre: autoscale-check requested by chris
sara: I'm on eng-sre — I'll review autoscale logs and sign off by 11:30. Also double-check rollback scripts.
maria: Minor ask — include a changelog entry under "behavior changes" since throttle alters latency profile for some customers.
alex: Good call. I'll draft a short blurb for the release notes after merge.
pat: Also reminder — shipping this week means we need to freeze feature flags on Thursday EOD. Any objections?
chris: No objections. I'll add a checklist item to the rollout playbook.
emma-design: UX copy PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/88 — added fallback messaging options.
alex: Blockers summary: SRE sign-off (sara), infra PR merge, docs copy (emma), changelog blurb. If all green, aiming to start canary rollout 16:30 PT today. If any blockers, shout here. :rocket:
maria: :thumbsup:
sara: on it
chris: LGTM"
